tools.name: generate_qr
tools.description: Generate a static QR code (never expires; content encoded directly, no redirect). Returns an image (PNG) or SVG text.

tools.name: create_dynamic_code
tools.description: Create an editable (dynamic) QR code that redirects via fixedqr.com/r/<id>. Requires a FixedQR API key (Authorization: Bearer fq_...) and an active plan. The redirect keeps working even if the plan lapses.

tools.name: update_dynamic_code
tools.description: Change the destination or label of an editable QR code you own. Requires a FixedQR API key and an active plan.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_dynamic_code" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
